abstract_sentences.text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks such as visual grounding, segmentation, and captioning.

evidence.anchor: remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks

abstract_sentences.text: However, their ability to perceive perceptual-level image features remains limited.

evidence.anchor: ability to perceive perceptual-level image features remains limited

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we present UniPercept-Bench, a unified framework for perceptual-level image understanding across three key domains: Aesthetics, Quality, Structure and Texture.

evidence.anchor: present UniPercept-Bench, a unified framework

abstract_sentences.text: We establish a hierarchical definition system and construct large-scale datasets to evaluate perceptual-level image understanding.

evidence.anchor: hierarchical definition system and construct large-scale datasets

abstract_sentences.text: Based on this foundation, we develop a strong baseline UniPercept trained via Domain-Adaptive Pre-Training and Task-Aligned RL, enabling robust generalization across both Visual Rating (VR) and Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks.

evidence.anchor: trained via Domain-Adaptive Pre-Training and Task-Aligned RL

abstract_sentences.text: UniPercept outperforms existing MLLMs on perceptual-level image understanding and can serve as a plug-and-play reward model for text-to-image generation.

evidence.anchor: outperforms existing MLLMs ... plug-and-play reward model

abstract_sentences.text: This work defines Perceptual-Level Image Understanding in the era of MLLMs and, through the introduction of a comprehensive benchmark together with a strong baseline, provides a solid foundation for advancing perceptual-level multimodal image understanding.

experimental_design.name: evaluated_models
experimental_design.description: The paper states 18 models in proprietary, leading open-source, and specialized groups, with GPT-4o, Llama-4-Scout, Gemini-2.5-pro, two Claude variants, LLaVA-OneVision, GLM, InternVL, QwenVL, ArtiMuse, DeQA, Q-Align, Q-Insight, and UniPercept represented.

ablation_inventory.name: adaptive_vs_threshold_reward
ablation_inventory.description: Table 16 compares threshold and adaptive rewards. Adaptive is higher for IQA Avg 0.824/0.827 versus 0.801/0.790 and ISTA 0.778/0.767 versus 0.303/0.334, while threshold IAA Avg 0.617/0.596 exceeds UniPercept 0.590/0.586. evidence.anchor: Adaptive Gaussian Soft Reward consistently outperforms the threshold-based formulation

ablation_inventory.name: without_domain_adaptive_pretraining
ablation_inventory.description: Removing DAPT lowers VR IAA Avg to 0.481/0.421, IQA Avg to 0.733/0.700, and ISTA to 0.755/0.732, and lowers VQA to 69.16/75.09/80.00% versus UniPercept 76.55/81.07/84.23%.

ablation_inventory.name: vqa_only_vs_vr_only

ablation_inventory.name: multi_domain_vs_single_domain

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 MLLM 的语义视觉能力延伸到可操作的 perceptual layer。IAA、IQA、ISTA 与 Domain–Category–Criterion 先定义对象，再由 VR/VQA 形成 benchmark，约 800K DAPT 与 task-aligned GRPO 训练 UniPercept，最后用跨域结果、T2I reward 和 profiles 展示用途。[p.2, Abstract/Introduction; p.4-p.10, Sections 3-5]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留三域边界、VR/VQA、QA 流程概览、Eq.1-Eq.3、两阶段训练、主模型比较和 T2I/application 点估计。[p.4-p.10, Sections 3-6]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 ISTA JSON 与 lexicon、Eq.4-Eq.13、31/4/9 个域 criterion 表、DAPT/RL 数据组成、两张消融表和定性 profiles；主文自足性因此主要在 ISTA 评分、数据构成和消融识别上下降。[p.16-p.27, Sections 8-12]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 三层 taxonomy、Figure 1/3/4 的操作图示、Figure 6 的训练接口和 Tables 1-4 的逐域 VR/VQA 对照形成清晰闭环。[p.1, p.3-p.8]
final_judgment.largest_gap: point-estimate 优势没有由 seed 重复、uncertainty、显著性、标注一致性、泄漏控制或 composite reward utility 支撑；Table 16 的 IAA 反例和 Table 5 的 per-dimension trade-off 也未被总结语句回收。[p.6-p.10, p.22-p.23]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 将模糊的视觉能力拆成互补且可观测的 perceptual dimensions，为每个维度同时设计连续评分与解释型 QA，并让训练、表格和应用沿同一 taxonomy 回收。[p.4-p.8]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于有属性标签、连续分数或可判定 QA 的图像评测。开放式人类偏好、真实部署和跨模型因果提升仍需独立 human protocol、重复统计、外部校准和明确定义的 composite objective。[p.6-p.10, p.22-p.23]
